output.summary: Shrub or small tree native to North America. It bears white flower clusters followed by red-to-black fruits. Only fully ripe fruit is edible and was part of Native American cuisine; unripe fruit is toxic and the stone is poisonous.
output.edibilityNote: Fully ripe fruit is edible and traditionally part of Native American cuisine; unripe fruit is toxic and the stone poisonous. Also made into preserves and wine.
